environment.execution: One benchmark process at a time; affinity/power/background load uncontrolled; filesystem/import caches may be OS-warm; no cross-host comparison.

conditions.arrival: One event immediately after a primed frame; no workers/backlog.
conditions.window: VirtualBackend injection through editing/layout/scheduler/renderer to acknowledged flush. Real monotonic time/sleep includes the unchanged 30 Hz frame ceiling; no busy wait.
conditions.limits: In-memory output acknowledgements; no OS terminal, human input, visual presentation, emulator/SSH/ConPTY, clipboard, domain/application, RSS or universal latency claim. Long input is stress, not representative Ledger usage.
conditions.memory: Separate untimed tracemalloc sample; includes fixture/session creation and instrumentation.
